Includes sky/sun/clouds, warm ground/dirt pile, cones/rocks/caution stripes, tracked excavator with cab/window/wheel/two-part arm/toothed bucket, sloth in hard hat/high-vis, and far more than four animated elements."},

  "richness_detail": {"score": 5, "reason": "Richly layered with 12 gradients, two patterns, distant hills/cranes, rocks, cones, caution stripes, sun rays, a dirt pile with falling clods, and detailed excavator/sloth shading across roughly 261 elements."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 4, "reason": "Balanced landscape framing: excavator left-center, dirt pile right, sun upper-right, clouds spread across the sky. Warm yellow/blue palette harmonizes; legible, uncluttered and polished."},
  "summary": "A charming, fully self-contained animated SVG that meets every hard requirement with rich detail and genuinely working multi-element motion, kept from perfection only by minor polish."
